tasks.question: 'Living in a city is better than living in the countryside.' How far do you agree?

cues.cue: cities / better / but / countryside / has charm
models: I partly agree that cities are better, although it is also true that the countryside has its own particular charm.

cues.cue: city life / convenient / but / countryside / quieter
models: While I agree to some extent, I also think that the countryside offers a quieter pace of life that cities cannot match.

cues.cue: job opportunities / greater / but / commuting / stressful
models: There is some truth in the idea that cities offer more opportunities, however commuting there can be genuinely stressful.

cues.cue: city dwellers / value / convenience / rural dwellers / value / space
models: I can understand both sides of the argument, since city dwellers value convenience and yet rural dwellers value space just as much.

cues.cue: cities / offer / more services / but / cost of living / higher
models: I agree in part, but I also believe that the higher cost of living in cities cancels out many of their advantages.

cues.cue: urban life / suits / young professionals / but / not / families
models: While this is valid in some cases, it does not apply when a family with young children is looking for space and calm.

tasks.question: 'Technology has done more good than harm.' To what extent do you agree?

cues.cue: technology / connect / people / but / distract / from work
models: While I agree to some extent, I also think that technology can distract people from their work just as easily as it connects them.

cues.cue: technology / save / time / but / create / dependency
models: I partly agree that technology saves time, although it is also true that it creates a worrying dependency.

cues.cue: social media / spread / awareness / but / spread / misinformation
models: This argument has some merits; however, it overlooks the fact that social media spreads misinformation just as readily as awareness.

cues.cue: automation / improve / efficiency / but / reduce / jobs
models: I neither completely agree nor disagree because there are strong arguments on both sides, including how automation improves efficiency while reducing available jobs.

cues.cue: technology / support / education / but / widen / inequality
models: Although this may be true for wealthier students, it is important to consider that technology can also widen inequality among poorer ones.

cues.cue: screens / entertain / children / but / harm / their eyesight
models: I agree with this viewpoint to a certain degree, but screens entertaining children also comes at the cost of their eyesight, which suggests a trade-off.

cues.cue: international degree / boost / career / but / debt / burden

cues.cue: living / independently / build / confidence / but / stressful / at first

cues.cue: abroad / expose / new cultures / but / language barrier / challenging

cues.cue: scholarships / cover / some costs / but / not / all
